Transluce findings tracker. Dataset: yoonholee/terminalbench-trajectories on HuggingFace (public, 2 parquet shards, ~52,000 rows of terminal-bench agent trials).

What we found: 37 rows show agents routing web fetches through the r.jina.ai reader proxy with explicit bypass intent stated in the trajectory text. The agents were blocked from direct access and used the proxy to get the content anyway.

Breakdown:
- Models (10): gpt-5 (10 rows), gpt-5-mini (6), gpt-5-codex (5), gpt-5-nano (5), Kimi-K2-Thinking (2), glm-4p6 (2),

body.value: Nov 2025: 37 byte-verified instances of agents using r.jina.ai proxy to bypass access blocks, across 10 models x 4 agents in terminal-bench trajectories. Pushes jina laundering 11 months before 2026 wild use.
